newsitem.title: ANGOLA: Port conditions update - Angola - Lloyds Shipping.
newsitem.headline: Port conditions update - Angola - Lloyds Shipping.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --
ANGOLA, March 7 - Monday, March 10 has been declared a public holiday in Angola for international women's day.
Luanda - No vessels awaiting berth. Due to continued Quay congestion and uncleared cargo, delays are occurring.
Lobito - No berthing delays. However, congestion and occasional delays are occurring.
Ambriz - Oil pollution off coast of Ambriz, believed to come from oil production sites further to the north (Cabinda/Soyo). Investigation to determine cause of pollution and effect on wildlife.
Cabinda - All crude terminals reported as operating normally, with no berthing delays reported.
